title: GeoSR: Geometric Spatial Reasoning for VLMs
summary: GeoSR is a framework designed to enhance spatial reasoning in Vision-Language Models by integrating 3D geometric cues. It employs geometry-unleashing masking and gated fusion to prevent models from relying on 2D visual shortcuts in both static and dynamic environments.
research_notes: Features specialized branches for static 3D scenes and dynamic monocular video. Established new SOTA on VSI-Bench and DSR-Bench.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the VLM-3R research lineage (May 2025) into a specialized framework for geometric spatial reasoning. In March 2026, it released unified code and model weights, introducing masking and adaptive fusion to achieve state-of-the-art performance on spatial benchmarks.
